protocol.metrics: Per-head visual conditioning, then equal-head mean. Question rows already averaged over real Question tokens. Entropy divided by log(576). Sink is frozen NON-ROI candidate share.
protocol.layer_alignment: Exit K removes tokens before L_K: before=L(K-1), after=L_K. Shared plot coordinate for boundary K is K-0.5; K0/32 have no two-sided Full boundary metric.
protocol.low_mass: Flag if either endpoint head-mean visual mass <1e-3 OR any endpoint head visual mass <1e-4. Keep all 48 in primary analysis.
protocol.sensitivity: Also exclude flagged images; separately recompute using only identical heads whose mass is >= threshold at BOTH endpoints. Keep image weighting equal; report no-head images. Raw Gain>0 primary; sensitivity Gain>1e-10 and >0.01 nats.
protocol.best_ties: All K within absolute 1e-10 nats of grid maximum are tied; choose smallest tied K deterministically and save all tied K. Strict classification remains margin>0, ties incorrect.
protocol.statistics: Image paired bootstrap percentile 95% CI, resampling whole images. Pearson and average-tie-rank Spearman; undefined constant replicates excluded and counted. Exploratory, no multiplicity correction or causal claim.
protocol.comparison: Gain>0 versus Gain<=0 Delta_ROI distributions; mean and median differences from image bootstrap. Do not pool five historical cases into main estimates.
